overloads.semanticRole: Merges the selection of cells intersecting a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document into a single cell.

discriminatedBy.note: single Object arg resolved as a range/element/document rather than a raw table reference

overloads.semanticRole: Merges a rectangular block of cells in a table, addressed by table reference and explicit start column/row (with optional column/row counts, default 1x1 growing to bottom-right).

discriminatedBy.note: 3-5 arg form addressing a table by reference plus explicit coordinates

constraints: If targetObj does not intersect a table or a selectable cell range, or intersects only a single cell, the command does nothing.
columnCount and rowCount each default to 1 when omitted; if both are omitted, the selection is a single cell and the command does nothing.
If startColumn+columnCount or startRow+rowCount exceed the table's dimensions, the merge is clamped to the maximum possible columns/rows (up to merging the whole table into one cell).
